Boxes.Name: /abbd-setup verify, install and hand over

Boxes.Name: topology diff
Boxes.Title: MOD-0049 topology diff: Compares two unit sets into sorted categories: units added and removed, contract signatures changed, contract code changed under the same signature, drawn relations between top-level units (an inside unit's relation lifted to its module), and reader couplings added.

Boxes.Name: impact walk

Boxes.Name: live links

Boxes.Name: unit explanation

Boxes.Name: strongest shortest path
